entities.name: Peregrine Dynamo
entities.description: Thran-powered mechanical soldier created by Urza, repaired, reprogrammed and befriended by Jhoira.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Artificer who found, repaired and reprogrammed the Peregrine Dynamo.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Creator of the mechanical soldiers that lay dormant for thousands of years.

events.summary: Jhoira encountered the Peregrine Dynamo wandering and declaring 'DO NOT BE ALARMED!'; she repaired and reprogrammed it, gaining a companion.
events.quote: Jhoira was able to repair and reprogram the construct, ultimately gaining a loyal and reliable companion.

relations.quote: The mechanical soldiers created by Urza had remained inactive for thousands of years
gaining a loyal and reliable companion
